****WEB REPORT**** APPROXIMATELY 50 GALLONS OF NO. 2 FUEL OIL WAS RELEASED TO A STORM WATER CONVEYANCE SYSTEM WHEN A FITTING ON AN OIL CIRCULATING SYSTEM ASSOCIATED WITH THE BOILER SYSTEM AT CITY HALL, 95 PLEASANT STREET, GARDNER, MA FAILED. THIS RELEASE WAS REPORTED TO MA DEP.
